title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final mass of the new particle, M = 2sqrt(2)m.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the total energy of the incident particle as E = 3m.

title: Invariant Mass Use
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the invariant mass squared formula correctly to relate energies and momenta.

title: Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the equations relating E, p, and M accurately.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as incorrect signs or factors in energy equations.
